description:
How to Make Homemade Chocolate Extract | Easy DIY Recipe with Cacao Nibs 🍫🍶

In this video, I’ll show you how to make chocolate extract using just alcohol, cacao nibs, and a jar! This simple DIY recipe is perfect for baking, cocktails, and desserts, adding rich chocolate flavor without the sweetness. Whether you’re a home baker, a foodie, or a DIY enthusiast, this is a recipe you’ll love.

👉 Ingredients You’ll Need:
 • Organic Cacao nibs – Packed with natural chocolate flavor.
 • Alcohol – Vodka or rum works great for extracting flavor but it must be 40% ABV
 • A jar – For steeping and storing.

💡 Why Make Chocolate Extract?
 • Adds a deep chocolate flavor without sugar.
 • Ideal for baking, ice cream, coffee, and cocktails.
 • No artificial flavors—just pure, homemade goodness!

⏰ Timestamps for Easy Navigation:
0:00 - Intro: Other commercail extracts
0:13 - Ingredients & Tools You’ll Need
0:44 - What you'll need
1:25 - What is a Cacao Nib?
2:45 - Putting it together
4:16 - The Long "Steep"
4:50 - How to use it
5:00 - Final Thoughts & Outro

📌 Pro Tips:
 • Use high-proof alcohol for faster extraction.
 • Shake the jar daily for better flavor infusion.
 • Let it steep for at least 4-6 weeks for the best results.

📸 Don’t forget to SUBSCRIBE for more DIY recipes, ice cream tips, and food science hacks! 🍨

comments.text:
Hello there.  In my new research, I want to make my own Almond Extract.  Now I've come across several methods, one in which most ppl on YouTube just use blanched almonds w/vodka, some ppl left for years, others left it for several weeks to months, end result was BAD, no taste. 
Next : I've researched a person using almonds & dried cherries w/vodka for 6-8 weeks. 
Some ppl use apricot kernels with vodka, however with the kernels, one must be diligent do two deadly ingredients that occured, which turns to poison. As I researched one MUST DISGARD the kernels at the appropriate time, and NEVER be reused. 

So can you advise me on ur use of Almond Extract & process. 
Thank you greatly,  these purchased extracts are costly.
comments.author: @pjaneheil

comments.text: All stone fruit pits/kernels have cyanide in them. Actual almond extract uses bitter almonds and bitter apricot kernels. It’s complex make to be honest and if you’re not sure, it’s safer to simply buy it. Bitter almonds are illegal in the US and other countries.
comments.author: @PolarIceCreamery
